listed_quote.quote: The Fund will be a publicly registered and offered non-traded business development company

announcement.quote: Triton Pacific and Prospect Capital Announce Shareholder Approval of Merger Between Triton Pacific Investment Corporation and Pathway Capital Opportunity Fund to Create TP Flexible Income Fund

deals.notes: Shareholders of both funds approved the merger on March 15, 2019 (96.2% and 96.0% of votes cast); the surviving fund is described as a non-traded BDC, so the pair is not listed. The excerpted filings do not state completion; the N-8F filed 2020-11-04 ticks 'Merger' as the reason for deregistration. The earlier 425s (seq 1-6) are shareholder-contact notices that do not name the merger. PWAY and TPIC appear only as defined abbreviations, not exchange tickers.
